honesty_rule: status=done means code exists and runs in-repo. It does NOT mean production-ready, device-verified, load-tested, or live payments. Use maturity: shipped | mvp | scaffold | unverified. Never mark scaffold as if it were shipped.
instructions_for_ai: Approved next milestone: RM-ANDROID-V2-VERTICAL-SLICE, see roadmap/RM-ANDROID-V2-VERTICAL-SLICE.md. Work in order: V2 Godot catalog integration, incremental map, real economic chain, V2 graphics/UI, signed Android APK/device verification. Main only; no HTML demo; clean new world, no V1 save migration. Do not deploy/reset live VPS without separate action. Mark only verified progress.

maturity_legend.shipped: Used end-to-end in normal play; no known major gaps for the claimed scope
maturity_legend.mvp: Works for local/dev play; balance/UX still need iteration
maturity_legend.scaffold: API/hooks/UI stubs exist; core behavior incomplete
maturity_legend.unverified: Code path exists but not proven on real device/env

items.title: Playable Android V2 economy vertical slice
items.notes: Phases 1–3 verified locally. A new wheat firm produces, ships and sells bread, then reinvests 5000 ₽; a new fuel firm buys crude, refines it and sells AI-92. Account, stock and active shipments survive reopening SQLite. Godot registration, reconnect and transfer controls passed headless. Next is Android UI and graphics; device profiling, signing and verification remain open.
